 Serie A - Game Week 12 Nov 21, 2026 - 12:00 Stadio Ennio Tardini DAZN will show Parma v Roma live and holds the rights to every Serie A match in 2026/27. The link below lets you subscribe and watch the match.
 Gian Piero Gasperini's Roma visit Alberto Gilardino's Parma at the Stadio Ennio Tardini on Saturday 21 November for a Serie A 2026/27 fixture.
 Roma arrive in Parma third in the table, with their squad gradually returning to full strength after a difficult spell with injuries. Paulo Dybala's return is the one they have been waiting for: he resumed training with the group on Tuesday 17 November and should be available for the trip.
 Parma sit 16th and head into the match with fewer certainties than their opponents. A 3-0 win over Atalanta in the previous round has restored Gilardino's confidence, but he will be without striker David Romero, who sustained a shoulder injury in the derby against Bologna.
 Roma have won three of the last four meetings between the sides, including a memorable 3-2 victory at the Tardini last May. Parma will try to reverse that trend in front of their own fans.
 Gasperini also faces a test of his squad's depth. Roma are competing in the league, Champions League and Coppa Italia, with a run of closely spaced fixtures that calls for as complete a squad as possible.
